_about: Ground heights round Goodwood out to about 60 km (the Downs, the coastal plain, the Solent and the Isle of Wight), metres above sea level, -1 = sea. From the AWS Terrain Tiles (Mapzen 'terrarium', zoom 11), sampled 17 Nov 2026 through the owner's built-in browser. Grid: east x and north y metres about lat 50.895, lon -0.742 (same axes as dem-course-20m.json). Rows south to north, columns west to east.
